source: Existing public Formula SAE hero photograph
method: Two overlapping continuous original-photo regions; soft alpha transition occurs only outside those regions. No individual component outlines or holes.
purpose: Preserve original suspension links, chassis, driver, wheels, gaps and source contact shadows without part-by-part clipping.
validation: Native browser raster check: protected regions are alpha255 throughout; source photo pixels and old immutable assets are unchanged.
limits: Region coordinates are photo presentation coordinates, not vehicle dimensions or engineering measurements. No generated/reconstructed parts or sharpening.
